content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Classification: deviation (fallback target).**

- Section 15 (p0105) is the only liability provision. It is mutual in form (exclusive remedy = direct damages; mutual exclusion of special/indirect/consequential damages) and mutually excludes breaches of Section 13 (IP indemnity, continued at p0090) and Section 14 (Confidentiality) from the limitation — so indemnification and confidentiality already sit outside any Section 15 limitation.
- No aggregate monetary cap exists anywhere in the document (searches for cap/aggregate/exceed/indemnify language returned nothing further), leaving our direct-damages exposure unlimited. That is a material failure of the fallback (mutual 12-months'-fees cap).
- Cure: one inserted sentence in Section 15 setting a mutual cap at fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim, with gross negligence and wilful misconduct outside the cap. The retained final sentence carries the indemnity/confidentiality carve-outs, so nothing was restated and no unrelated text was touched. Preferred extras (USD 1,000,000 floor, data protection/fraud/IP carve-outs, payment-obligation exclusion) were noted rather than drafted, per the fallback target.
